profileUse.title: Authorization for profile use and presentation
profileUse.body:
I freely and voluntarily authorize Visible Outsource, S.A. de C.V., hereinafter “Visible”, to receive, review, store, analyze, process, and present my curriculum vitae, professional profile, work experience, academic background, skills, salary expectations, availability, references, and other information related to my candidacy.

This authorization applies to recruitment, selection, headhunting, outsourcing, staffing, professional services, temporary projects, and future job or professional opportunities.

I authorize Visible to share my professional profile with current or potential clients, domestic or international, solely for purposes related to evaluation, interview, selection, hiring, project assignment, or provision of outsourced services.

I understand that presenting my profile does not guarantee an interview, job offer, or hiring.

personalData.title: Personal data protection
personalData.body:
I authorize Visible to process my personal and professional data exclusively for recruitment, selection, headhunting, outsourcing, staffing, talent administration, and presentation of job or professional opportunities.

Visible commits to using my information confidentially, responsibly, and limited to the purposes stated above.

I may request updating, correction, or deletion of my data by writing to the contact email indicated by Visible.

confidentiality.title: Process confidentiality
confidentiality.body:
I commit to keeping confidential the information I receive during the process, including data about clients, vacancies, interviews, tests, conditions, proposals, methodologies, contacts, documents, or any information shared by Visible or its clients.

This information must be used only for my participation in the corresponding process.

communications.title: Channeling of process-related communications
communications.body:
I acknowledge that Visible performs professional management of search, contact, evaluation, selection, and presentation of candidates to its clients.

Therefore, if during the process or within the months following my formal presentation to a client I receive a communication, interview, proposal, or direct offer related to the same vacancy, client, or process managed by Visible, I commit to informing Visible and channeling the corresponding communication through the company.

This provision does not limit my right to work, seek employment, participate in other processes, or accept job opportunities. Its purpose is to maintain process traceability, protect information confidentiality, and recognize the professional management performed by Visible.

nonExclusivity.title: Non-exclusivity and freedom to work
nonExclusivity.body:
I declare that my participation as a candidate does not imply exclusivity, does not limit my right to work, does not prevent me from participating in other processes, and does not constitute an automatic employment relationship with Visible or its clients.

An employment, commercial, or service relationship will exist only if a contract, offer letter, service agreement, or corresponding onboarding document is later signed.

electronicSignature.title: Electronic signature and acceptance
electronicSignature.body:
I accept that this form may be signed physically or electronically through platforms such as DocuSign, PandaDoc, or other equivalent tools used by Visible.

An electronic signature, digitized signature, click acceptance, digital confirmation, or validation through an electronic platform will constitute a free and informed expression of my consent for the processing and presentation of my professional profile under this document.

Visible may retain the electronic evidence generated by the platform used, including date, time, email address, IP address, audit log, signed document version, and other supporting technical elements.

This acceptance does not constitute an employment relationship, promise of employment, or hiring obligation.

acceptance.title: Acceptance (candidate signature and details)
acceptance.body: I declare that I have read and understood this document, that I voluntarily participate in the processes managed by Visible, and that I authorize the processing and presentation of my information according to the stated purposes.

tips.title: Tip for your application
tips.tip1: Make sure your email and phone number are up to date.
tips.tip2: Upload your resume in PDF format.
tips.tip3: Verify that all your information is correct before submitting.
tips.tip4: Make sure you meet the main requirements of the vacancy.
tips.tip5: Stay alert for emails and calls after applying.
tips.tip6: Use a professional file name for your CV.
tips.tip7: Check the spelling of your information before continuing.
tips.tip9: Do not forget to include your most recent work experience.
tips.tip10: Confirm that your availability matches what is requested in the vacancy.

page.title: Privacy Policy
page.intro: This Privacy Policy describes how {productName} ("we", "us", or "our") collects, uses, and protects personal information when you use our applicant tracking and recruitment platform.

informationWeCollect.title: Information We Collect
informationWeCollect.p1: We may collect information that you provide directly, information generated through your use of the service, and limited profile information from third-party sign-in providers when you choose to authenticate with them.

items.profilePicture: Profile picture, when available from a sign-in provider
items.accountIdentifiers: Account identifiers and authentication provider information
items.professionalInfo: Professional or application-related information you submit through the platform
items.technicalUsage: Technical and usage information, such as browser type, device information, and log data related to your interactions with the service

howWeUse.title: How We Use Your Information

items.operate: Provide, operate, and maintain the platform
items.authenticate: Authenticate users and manage account access
items.recruitment: Support recruitment workflows, including candidate applications and hiring processes enabled by your organization
items.support: Respond to support requests and service-related inquiries
items.improve: Improve reliability, security, and performance of the service

howWeUse.p2: We process personal information only for legitimate purposes related to operating {productName} and providing the features you choose to use.

linkedInSignIn.title: LinkedIn Sign-In
linkedInSignIn.p1: If you choose to sign in with LinkedIn, we may receive basic profile information from LinkedIn to create or authenticate your account. Depending on your LinkedIn settings and the permissions you approve, this may include:
linkedInSignIn.p2: We use this information to identify you, establish your session, and display your profile within the platform where applicable. We do not control LinkedIn's own privacy practices. Please review LinkedIn's privacy policy to understand how LinkedIn handles your information.

dataSharing.title: Data Sharing
dataSharing.p1: We do not sell your personal information. We may share information only in limited circumstances, such as:

items.serviceProviders: With service providers that help us operate the platform, under appropriate confidentiality and security obligations
items.organization: With your organization or authorized users when needed to support recruitment and hiring workflows
items.legal: When required by law, regulation, legal process, or governmental request
items.protection: To protect the rights, safety, and security of users, our service, or others

dataSecurity.title: Data Security
dataSecurity.p1: We take reasonable administrative, technical, and organizational measures designed to protect personal information against unauthorized access, loss, misuse, or alteration. However, no method of transmission over the internet or electronic storage is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

dataRetention.title: Data Retention
dataRetention.p1: We retain personal information for as long as reasonably necessary to provide the service, fulfill the purposes described in this policy, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce our agreements. Retention periods may vary depending on the type of information and how it is used within the platform.

yourRights.title: Your Rights
yourRights.p1: Depending on your location and applicable law, you may have rights regarding your personal information, which may include the right to access, correct, delete, or restrict certain processing of your data, or to object to certain uses.
yourRights.p2: To exercise these rights or submit a privacy-related request, please contact us using the details below. We may need to verify your identity before responding to certain requests.

contact.title: Contact
contact.p1: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or our data practices, contact us at:
